direction: A compact notification center opened from a bell in the top header while the employee remains on the Bảng công overview. Use a refined right-side drawer around 440 pixels wide, an unread count on the bell, a prominent required-policy row, lightweight recent notification rows, and a single primary button labeled Đọc và xác nhận. The payroll screen behind it should remain clearly recognizable.

A dedicated full-page Thông báo nội bộ inbox using a calm master-detail layout. A narrow left column contains grouped notification rows with unread and required states; the wide reading pane shows the selected policy, version, effective date, a concise Điểm thay đổi section, privacy note, and a sticky primary action Tôi đã đọc và hiểu.
